<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | The corpus is data vendored twice; change both in one commit and let the existing oracle test prove they agree. Removal is the only operation: no additions, no reordering beyond deleting entries, no algorithm change. The judgement is deliberately conservative: a word that a reasonable reader could take as sensitive, judgemental or someone else's IP goes, even if its main sense is innocent. Existing ids are stored, not recomputed (verify; stop if not). |
| composition_root | crates/core/src/name_corpus.rs and .omp/extensions/pij/core/name-corpus.ts |
| contracts | EXCLUDED_NAME_WORDS (both runtimes): every removed word, and the test that no list (including each ship-name word) contains one, assets/audit.md: removed word, list, category; reviewed counts per list |
| seams | crates/core/src/name_corpus.rs, .omp/extensions/pij/core/name-corpus.ts, crates/core/tests/memorable_ids.rs, .omp/extensions/pij/core/memorable-id.test.ts |
